lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# Shared leaf utilities (#1646): the one home-dir resolver + civil-date parsing.
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): `cli_main` (the `main` wrapper) + `emit` (the lean-TSV-vs-JSON dispatch
# this CLI re-inlined in every verb arm). Replaced the `bsc-sqlite-util` print_json dependency.
# Read-only access to the metrics DB (perf.db) for `bsc-logs perf` (#1716). `bundled` matches the
# rest of the workspace (plandb/skilldb/research) so the CLI carries its own SQLite, no system dep.
# Project completion (issues done/total) for `bsc logs metrics` (#3449) — Tauri-free, bundled SQLite.
# Telemetry attribution (D6): TelemetryTags — the lane + writer a perf row records, and the explicit
# `store migrate` that adds those columns. The `conn` feature carries it.
# TEST-ONLY, and only for one test. `the_reader_parses_exactly_what_the_emitter_writes` drives the
# REAL emitter (`bsc_llm::ratelimit::RateLimitLog`) and parses its output back, so the two halves of
# the headroom contract cannot drift. A hand-written fixture would only prove this parser agrees with
# whoever typed the fixture. `bsc-llm` does not depend on `logs`, so there is no cycle.
